intro.heading: Apply to CCC Church Residency.
intro.text: Applying is a simple two-step process. Once we have both pieces, a member of our residency leadership team will be in touch within a few business days about next steps.

fit.heading: Is this a fit?
points: You sense a call to explore vocational ministry
You have a bachelor's degree, or you want to complete thirty credit hours of Bible and theology through Crown College
You can commit to two years in Omaha (three on the counseling licensure track)
You have your own vehicle and transportation

steps.title: Complete the questionnaire
steps.text: Download the Word document and answer each question in about 3–5 sentences. Save it with your name in the file name.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.text: Fill out the application below and upload your completed questionnaire.

steps.title: Hear from us
steps.text: A member of our residency leadership team will reach out within a few business days about next steps.

application.heading: Application
application.text: All fields marked with an asterisk are required. Files must be Word or PDF, under 8 MB total.
application.success: Thanks! Your application is in. We'll be in touch within a few business days.

info.heading: Not ready to apply?
info.text: Tell us a little about yourself and we'll send you more information about the residency.
info.success: Thanks! We'll be in touch soon.

contact.heading: Have a question?
contact.text: Send us a note and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
contact.success: Thanks! Your message is on its way. We'll get back to you soon.

items.a: Two years. Residents on the Master of Arts in Counseling with state licensure track serve three years.
Residents raise their own monthly financial support, and CCC matches donations up to $400 a month per resident.

items.q: What does the master's degree cost?
items.a: Nothing. Your degree through Crown College is fully funded, including books and fees.
Yes. Coursework through Crown College is online, so you can complete it alongside your ministry work. Plan on 12–18 hours a week.
You can live with a CCC host family in a private room, with no rent or utilities. [Learn about host families](/host-families/).

items.q: Do I need a college degree?
items.a: No. Residents without a bachelor's degree complete the Crown 30 certificate, thirty credit hours of Bible and theology.

items.q: Can I choose my ministry area?
items.a: Yes. You'll choose a primary area of focus and work with a mentor in that area. [See the areas of focus](/program/#areas).
Yes. Residents provide their own vehicle and transportation.
